go_tracks.track_a: XENO_EXECUTABLE_CONVERGENCE: executable typed ingress admission added under the current-facing Xeno root

observed_problem.finding: HCU route decision identity is derived from routing output plus generation and can alias materially distinct causal events selecting the same lanes; current provider admission is also denylist-based. This receipt addresses the event-ingress identity primitive only and does not claim the provider/engine identity gap is closed.

hypothesis: A deterministic typed ingress identity that binds causal_id, generation, provenance, normalized timestamps, permissions/capability scope, resource budget and immutable payload digest will remove causal event aliasing before XPU/XCU cognition while remaining reusable across GRID10, COGSIM10, WM_TEST, NESTED_SIM and SCALEOUT.
counterhypothesis: Typed ingress adds latency and schema rigidity without materially improving causal auditability because downstream routing/effect receipts could bind raw payloads directly.

candidate.identity_formula: sha256(canonical normalized packet fields including payload_sha256)
candidate.authority_boundary: admission/binding only; no semantic truth promotion and no effect authority

deterministic_component_evidence.environment: connected isolated ChatGPT container; exact tested local bytes matched the subsequently fetched Git blob identities

unusual_experiment.protocol: Generate 512 materially distinct HCU_REACTIVE_EVENT/v1 inputs intentionally constrained to select the same legacy router lanes, then compare legacy route-decision digest cardinality with Xeno ingress digest cardinality.
unusual_experiment.performance_boundary: container microtiming is diagnostic only and is not product/hardware throughput evidence

fusion.reason: The causal alias discriminator supports one reusable ingress identity primitive. It should become the immutable input identity consumed by HCU/XPU route receipts rather than adding parallel router-specific event hashes.

runtime_credit.reason: No exact full-repository authorized Vercel Sandbox build/runtime was available through the connected surface; component execution only.

next_exact_discriminator: Wire ingress_sha256 into the single retained HCU route identity together with positively resolved local engine identity, then prove: different admitted ingress -> different route digest when routing result is identical; same exact replay -> identical route digest; downstream inference receipt echoes ingress, route and engine identities.
